verification_metadata: final/verification.json projects the 36 timing cases from the complete verifier metadata so saved summary regeneration stays small.
raw_receipts: Unmodified gzip output of the verifier; full input/output UTF-8 encoded as base64, exact typed errors and metadata for every case. Baseline and candidate files are byte-identical.
commands: Per-process command/stderr logs consolidated losslessly as compressed JSONL; each record retains its original relative path.
source_snapshots: The measured source, driver and runner snapshots are retained for each cohort. Compiled modules, binaries and caches are excluded.
